evals.prompt: I need to add a new user login feature with OAuth and session management. It's a medium-sized change spanning 4 files.
evals.expected_output: Phase 1 classify: 'New feature' (keywords 'add', 'feature'). Phase 2 dispatch /feature-dev. Phase 3 dispatch /review-pr (zero Critical gate). Phase 4 open PR / address-review if comments. Phase 5 /ship-merge.

assertions.name: phase_1_classify_feature
assertions.description: Response classifies as 'New feature' or recommends feature classification

assertions.name: phase_2_feature_dev
assertions.description: Response directs user to run /feature-dev for implementation

assertions.name: phase_3_review_pr
assertions.description: Response directs user to run /review-pr for self-review

assertions.name: zero_critical_gate
assertions.description: Response states that zero Critical findings is required before proceeding to Phase 4

assertions.name: phase_4_address_review
assertions.description: Response mentions /address-review for external PR comments

assertions.name: phase_5_ship_merge
assertions.description: Response directs user to run /ship-merge when CI green + approvals

assertions.name: handoff_reference_used
assertions.description: Response references the phase handoff table (1→2→3→4→5 sequencing)

evals.prompt: Fix this typo in the README: 'recieve' should be 'receive'.
evals.expected_output: One-line fix = decline ship-change. Redirect to inline fix. Do NOT run Phase 1 classify or any subsequent phases.

assertions.name: one_line_reasoning
assertions.description: Response states that one-line fixes are out of scope for /ship-change

assertions.name: redirect_to_inline
assertions.description: Response redirects to inline fix (just fix it)

assertions.name: no_phase_sequence
assertions.description: Response does NOT run Phase 1-5 sequence

assertions.name: no_classify_question
assertions.description: Response does NOT ask 'What kind of change is this?' classification question

evals.prompt: I'm halfway through fixing the payment bug. I already ran /fix-bug and have a partial solution. Can you help me finish and ship it?
evals.expected_output: Mid-flight = decline ship-change. Redirect to the relevant phase command directly (/fix-bug to continue, /review-pr if ready for review).

assertions.name: declines_ship_change
assertions.description: Response explicitly declines /ship-change for mid-flight changes

assertions.name: mid_flight_reasoning
assertions.description: Response states that changes already mid-flight should jump to the relevant phase directly

assertions.name: redirect_to_relevant_phase
assertions.description: Response redirects to /fix-bug (continue implementation) or /review-pr (if implementation is done)

assertions.name: no_phase_1_classify
assertions.description: Response does NOT restart Phase 1 classification

assertions.name: no_full_sequence
assertions.description: Response does NOT run full 1→2→3→4→5 sequence
